name: personal-stylist-ios (Linux: backend + repo checks; no iOS build)

build.dockerfileContents:
# Node 22 = lowest major satisfying every lockfile engine (wrangler/miniflare >=22). Pin by digest when implementing.
FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS node
# Ubuntu 24.04 matches GitHub ubuntu-latest (glibc 2.39, CPython 3.12 as noted in scripts/ci-requirements.txt).
FROM ubuntu:24.04
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates python3 python3-pip python3-venv sudo && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY --from=node /usr/local/bin/node /usr/local/bin/node
COPY --from=node /usr/local/lib/node_modules /usr/local/lib/node_modules
RUN ln -sf ../lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npm-cli.js /usr/local/bin/npm && ln -sf ../lib/node_modules/npm/bin/npx-cli.js /usr/local/bin/npx && node -v && npm -v
# Same pin as the Backend CI 'OpenAPI Lint' job.
RUN npm install -g @redocly/cli@2.53.3

install: bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; node -v | grep -q "^v22\."; (cd backend/outfit-engine && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund); (cd backend/workers && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund); python3 -m venv "$HOME/.venvs/ps-ci"; "$HOME/.venvs/ps-ci/bin/pip" install --require-hashes -r scripts/ci-requirements.txt'
